useCases.name: Primary Action
useCases.when: Main CTA — highest hierarchy action on a page or modal
useCases.example: Submit form, Confirm purchase, Sign Up

useCases.name: Secondary Action
useCases.when: Supporting action alongside a Primary, lower visual emphasis
useCases.example: Save Draft (next to Publish), Cancel (next to Confirm)

useCases.name: Tertiary / Outlined Action
useCases.when: Low-emphasis action, often used in cards or list rows without background fill

useCases.name: Inline Text Action
useCases.when: Minimal chrome action embedded within content or toolbars
useCases.example: Forgot password?, See all results, Undo

useCases.name: Disabled Interaction
useCases.when: Action not yet available — form incomplete, insufficient permissions

namingAudit.conventionDetected: Title Case properties, ALL CAPS size values, Title Case state/type values, camelCase boolean & text properties

issues.suggested: Has Icon Left, Has Icon Right
issues.reason: Boolean props should follow 'Has [X]' or 'Is [X]' prefix convention for clarity in Figma property panel
Text props should use a semantic noun in Title Case; 'buttonText' is camelCase and redundantly describes the component rather than the slot

issues.current: MD Primary Disabled uses 14px/20px (Subtitle-MD 1), while MD Primary Default/Hover uses 15px/24px
issues.suggested: Unify MD size to consistent font style — likely 15px/24px for all MD states
issues.reason: Inconsistent font sizes within the same Size tier creates visual jank on state transitions

issues.current: Type=Text Button only exists for Size=SM and Size=MD
issues.suggested: Confirm intentional — document as design decision if Text Button is not needed at XL/LG
issues.reason: Incomplete variant matrix can confuse developers expecting all Size × Type combinations to exist

issues.current: Tertiary Hover shows solid fill background (same as Primary Hover), losing its outlined identity
issues.suggested: Consider a lighter hover fill for Tertiary to preserve its visual hierarchy vs Primary
issues.reason: Tertiary Default has outlined style, but on Hover it becomes visually identical to Primary Hover — hierarchy collapse
